task_instance: Run the bundled chen2020 SPM battery experiment (80% SOC, 0.5C discharge 600s, rest 120s, 0.5C charge 600s) via scripts/simulate_battery.py to produce the baseline curve.csv, tight-tolerance.csv, refined-mesh.csv, parameters.json and report.json, and verify the reference result (integrated charge 0.4166667 Ah, ~2.17 mV mesh-doubling voltage change).
blocker_detail: The core deliverable requires executing the bundled Python helper (scripts/simulate_battery.py) inside a Python 3.12 environment with PyBaMM 26.9.0.0, pybammsolvers (IDAKLU), NumPy and CasADi installed. The office-assistant runtime cannot run code or shell commands, cannot install packages, and cannot produce the simulation output files. The skill's own files (SKILL.md, scripts/simulate_battery.py, assets/chen2020-protocol.json, references) are all present, so this is not a missing-skill-file situation; the blocker is purely the lack of code execution and package installation in this runtime. Per the run rules I did not write a replacement, stub or mock of the PyBaMM helper and did not fabricate its numerical outputs.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: it mandates creating a Python 3.12 venv, installing pybamm==26.9.0.0 and pybammsolvers==0.10.0, then invoking battery-env/bin/python scripts/simulate_battery.py on a protocol JSON to emit curve.csv/report.json/etc. Confirmed the bundled files exist in the skill tree: scripts/simulate_battery.py (~13 KB) and assets/chen2020-protocol.json (340 B). Producing and verifying any of the stated deliverables (CSV curves, report.json with numerical-convergence comparisons, charge-integral check) requires executing this Python helper, which the runtime does not permit. No simulation could be produced or verified; result.json is the only file written to the work directory.
